content:
sam_account: Hey — started getting a bunch of 401s around 09:12 UTC, and when the request succeeds the generated text is truncated / lower-capability. Also our embed consumer started rejecting vectors (dim mismatch). Request IDs: req_0a9f12c3, req_0a9f22d9. Example curl we used to repro:

sam_account: ```
curl -i https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H \"Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED\" \n  -H \"x-redwood-region: eu-west-1\" \n  -d '{"model":"rwd-llm-3.1","input":"Summarize the invoice"}'
```

sam_account: We saw a billing spike too (unexpected token counts). Any idea what changed? :confused:

lina_support: Sorry — looking. Can you confirm whether this is a single customer or many? Anything in error body besides 401? :eyes:

sam_account: Multiple tenants. The 401s have body: `{\"error\":{\"message\":\"authentication failed\",\"code\":401}}` but header shows `x-redwood-host: standby-ap-south-1` which is odd. The token is valid and works for other calls.

lina_support: Thanks. We're seeing a routing spike in metrics for eu-west->ap fallback around the same time. I'm going to escalate and grab logs. Can you confirm the account id and recent invoice id?

sam_account: acct_42x, invoice inv_2026_03_15_84. Also the embed consumer error: expecting 1024 dims, got 768.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout completed in us-west-2 at 2026-03-15T08:55:12Z :rocket:

omar_runtime: omar_runtime: grabbing router logs for that timeframe. Early findings: there was an auth-probe job that retried via standby region due to a transient control-plane timeout. The standby pool's fallback policy included a legacy variant `rwd-llm-3-legacy-quant` which is quantized and uses `tokenizer_v1`. That variant is incompatible with `rwd-llm-3.1` tokenizer (v2).

meera_ml: meera_ml: Confirming — legacy-quant uses a 768-dim embed head and tokenizer_v1 (vocab 50256). rwd-llm-3.1 uses tokenizer_v2 and 1024-dim embeddings. If traffic silently hit the legacy variant, you'll see shorter outputs and embed dim mismatch. That also explains lower token counts reported (quant path counts tokens differently) and unexpected billing variance.

lina_support: So two issues: auth probe -> route to standby -> fallback to legacy variant. We need a mitigation plan.

omar_runtime: omar_runtime: Quick mitigation: I can pin your account's routing to eu-west-1 (force route) and add an explicit model whitelist for the session. That should stop calls hitting standby. Also disabling that fallback entry in standby pool asap.

lina_support: I'll apply a temporary credit for the billing spike and keep you posted. Do you have a reproducible curl we can run after we pin?

sam_account: Yes — same curl above reproduces the 401 if region header omitted. If I set `x-redwood-region: ap-south-1` I get success but with 768-dim embed. So reproducer:

sam_account: ```
curl -i https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \n  -H \"Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED\" \n  -H \"x-redwood-region: ap-south-1\" \n  -d '{"model":"rwd-embed-3","input":"invoice #123"}'
```

meera_ml: meera_ml: Please capture `x-redwood-model`, `x-redwood-variant`, and `x-redwood-host` response headers for the failing requests — that proves which model served it. Also dump the raw tokenization for the prompt using both tokenizers: `tokenizer_v1.encode(...)` vs `tokenizer_v2.encode(...)` to show drift.

omar_runtime: omar_runtime: I've queued a hotfix: remove `rwd-llm-3-legacy-quant` from standby fallback list and change auth-probe retry policy so probes don't flip to standby. Deploying in 2 mins.

lina_support: Done: pinned acct_42x to eu-west-1 for 24h, issued $120 credit to cover overage, escalated to eng-ml to validate tokenizer alignment across standby images. Can you validate on your side @sam_account? :pray:

sam_account: Checking now...

sam_account: After pin — generation works, no 401s, output restored. Embeds now 1024 dims. Thanks.

meera_ml: meera_ml: We'll run a full inventory of standby model images — verifying tokenizer binary, vocab hash, and embed head dims. If we find mismatches we'll bake in a compatibility check that prevents fallback to variants with tokenizer or embed-dim mismatch.

omar_runtime: omar_runtime: Also adding logging alerts if `x-redwood-variant` != expected family for critical accounts.

lina_support: I'll keep the thread open until eng-ml confirms the image fixes and the rollback of standby fallback is verified. Thanks everyone for quick triage :thumbsup:

sam_account: Appreciate the quick help. Leaving thread open for final confirmation on root cause and permanent fix.
